'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**At least 39 people are dead while 165 others are rescued when two [[list of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|boats sink off]] the coast of [[Tunisia]] while trying to reach [[Lampedusa]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/9/at-least-39-die-as-two-migrant-boats-sink-off-tunisia (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alaska]]
*****Governor [[Mike Dunleavy (politician)|Mike Dunleavy]] announces that [[Alaska]] will drop its eligibility requirements for the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] and allow all residents over the age of 16 to receive it, thereby becoming the first state to do so. The state has also led other states in the percentage of its population to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19. [https://apnews.com/article/alaska-coronavirus-pandemic-ee1a9f6cb008a8f983bb230adbb61575 (AP)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Dakota]]
*****[[Governor of North Dakota|North Dakota Governor]] [[Doug Burgum]] receives the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://apnews.com/article/public-health-health-coronavirus-pandemic-bismarck-north-dakota-f80386c5a6d24c434a70651acdecebe2 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in British Columbia]], [[Lineage P.1]]
*****[[British Columbia]] reports its first three cases of Lineage P.1 variant first detected in [[Brazil]]. [https://vancouversun.com/news/local-news/covid-19-b-c-reports-arrival-of-brazilian-variant-as-mutant-cases-accelerate (''Vancouver Sun'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]]
*****[[First Minister of Scotland|First Minister]] [[Nicola Sturgeon]] announces that four people from two households will be able to meet outdoors from March 12, three days sooner than expected, as part of easing of their national [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/four-people-from-two-households-able-to-meet-outdoors-in-scotland-from-friday-as-lockdown-eased-12240897 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Estonia]], [[variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
****The [[Estonia]]n [[Government of Estonia|government]] approves new measures to lockdown the entire country from March 11 until April 11 due to the spread of variants of SARS-CoV-2, which means that non-essential shops will be closed, primary schools will shift to [[remote learning]], and groups of more than two people will be banned. [https://news.err.ee/1608136519/government-approves-lock-down-measures-starting-thursday (Eesti Rahvusringhääling)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[President of Italy|Italian President]] [[Sergio Mattarella]] receives the first dose of the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.wantedinrome.com/news/italys-president-mattarella-gets-covid-19-vaccine-in-rome.html (''Wanted in Rome'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Macedonia]]
****[[Prime Minister of North Macedonia|Prime Minister]] [[Zoran Zaev]] confirms that the [[Government of North Macedonia|government]] will impose a nationwide curfew from 10:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. local time from tomorrow until March 22, as well as a mandatory 14-day [[quarantine]] for all travelers from [[Africa]], in order to reduce the spread of [[COVID-19]]. [https://hr.n1info.com/english/news/north-macedonia-orders-nationwide-curfew/ (N1)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] grants approval for the [[Sinovac]] [[CoronaVac]] [[vaccine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-ukraine-vaccine/update-1-ukraine-approves-chinas-sinovac-covid-19-vaccine-idUSL1N2L70WI (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sudan]]
****[[Sudan]] begins a [[vaccination]] campaign against COVID-19 beginning with medical workers. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/03/09/Coronavirus-Sudan-launches-COVID-19-vaccination-roll-out-for-medical-workers (Al Arabiya English)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
****[[Tunisia]] receives its first major shipment of 30,000 doses of the [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] vaccine. [https://www.africanews.com/2021/03/09/tunisia-receives-first-major-vaccine-delivery/ (Africanews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe]]
****[[Zimbabwe]] grants emergency use authorization for four COVID-19 vaccines, including [[China]]'s [[CoronaVac]] and [[BBIBP-CorV]], [[Russia]]'s [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]], and [[India]]'s [[Covaxin]]. [https://www.news24.com/amp/news24/africa/news/covid-19-zimbabwe-authorises-sputnik-v-sinovac-vaccines-for-emergency-use-20210309 (''News24'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****[[Prime Minister of Cambodia|Prime Minister]] [[Hun Sen]] orders a temporary closure of the [[Cambodia|country]]'s civil institutions and reduces their on-site employees by 90% for at least a week, with the exception of [[Royal Cambodian Armed Forces|military]] and health workers due to an increase in COVID-19 cases. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/cambodian-pm-orders-temporary-closure-of-civil-institutions-as-covid-19-cases-rise (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****The [[Indonesia]]n [[National Agency of Drug and Food Control of Republic of Indonesia|Food and Drug Authority]] approves the emergency use of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] vaccine. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-03-09/astrazeneca-covid-vaccine-cleared-for-emergency-use-in-indonesia (Bloomberg News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] surpasses 600,000 total COVID-19 cases. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/03/09/21/covid-19-cases-in-philippines-top-600000-as-infections-in-ncr-remain-high (ABS-CBN News and Current Affairs)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports a record 1,972 new deaths in the past 24 hours amid slow [[vaccination]] rollout and overwhelmed hospitals, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 268,370. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20210310-hospitals-overwhelmed-as-brazil-reaches-new-daily-covid-19-death-record (France 24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]], [[Immigration policy of the Joe Biden administration]]
**The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] grants [[temporary protected status]] to [[Venezuelans in the United States|Venezuelans]] living in the [[United States]]. The decision will allow thousands of Venezuelan migrants to stay and work legally in the U.S., and it will remain in effect for 18 months. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-56333605 (BBC News)]
*[[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]], [[Myanmar–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Myanmar]] recalls its [[List of ambassadors of Myanmar to the United Kingdom|Ambassador to the United Kingdom]] Kyaw Zwar Minn after he publicly called for the release of jailed [[State Counsellor of Myanmar|State Counsellor]] [[Aung San Suu Kyi]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/myanmar-recalls-ambassador-in-uk-after-he-called-for-release-of-detained-leader-aung-san-suu-kyi-12240972 (Sky News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2017–2018 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**The [[European Parliament]] votes to strip [[Carles Puigdemont]], [[Toni Comín]], and [[Clara Ponsatí]] of their parliamentary immunity, allowing Spanish prosecutors to [[extradite]] them to Spain and prosecute them for [[sedition]] and [[embezzlement]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/mar/09/eu-parliament-strips-carles-puigdemont-and-two-other-catalans-of-immunity (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Núria Calduch]] becomes the first female Secretary of the [[Pontifical Biblical Commission]] named by [[Pope Francis]]. [https://catholicphilly.com/2021/03/news/world-news/pope-names-woman-scholar-as-secretary-of-biblical-commission/ (Catholic Philly)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Exploration of the Moon]]
**The [[China National Space Administration]] and [[Roscosmos]] sign a [[memorandum of understanding]] to establish a joint lunar [[space station]]. Roscosmos Director General [[Dmitry Rogozin]] says that the space station will be a "complex of experimental research facilities created on the surface or in the orbit of the [[Moon]]", and will be available for use by "international partners". [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20210309-russia-and-china-agree-to-build-joint-moon-space-station (France 24)]
